name: @projexlight/sdk-taxonomy
summary: AI-driven taxonomy + extraction-schema layer: declare what fields you want pulled out of free-form text (claim descriptions, support tickets, support email bodies) + the model + prompt template + few-shot examples that do it. Versioned, with migration plans so a taxonomy change doesn't silently invalidate older extractions. Foundation for any document-understanding workflow.

endpoints.description: Activate a draft taxonomy version; new extractions run against it.

events.name: taxonomy.version.published.v1
events.description: New taxonomy version published; carries field-set diff vs. prior.

events.name: taxonomy.extraction.completed.v1
events.description: Extraction run finished; carries source_hash + fields_extracted + cost.

events.name: taxonomy.migration.planned.v1
events.description: Migration plan generated for moving older extractions to the new version.

models.description: Per-version schema: field defs (name, type, required, validator).
Per-version prompt: system + few-shot + provider + model_id.
Plan for moving older extractions onto the new version: re-run policy, field re-mapping.

hooks.name: publishVersion
hooks.description: Publish a new taxonomy version (draft → active). Idempotent on (name, version).

hooks.name: extractFields
hooks.description: Run extraction on a source text against the active version; cached on source_hash.

hooks.name: planMigration
hooks.description: Generate a migration plan for older extractions; preview only — caller decides whether to apply.

hooks.name: applyMigration
hooks.description: Apply a planned migration; re-runs flagged extractions on the new version.

scenarios.title: Publish v2 of the auto-claims extraction taxonomy
scenarios.when_to_use: Insurance team adds 3 new fields they want pulled from claim narratives.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Version published + activated. Future extractions use v2; older extractions stay on v1 until migrated.

scenarios.title: Pull structured fields out of an incoming claim narrative
scenarios.when_to_use: Inbound claim email arrives via sdk-parsing; extractFields against the active taxonomy version returns structured data.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Structured field map + per-field confidence returned. Cached on source_hash so re-runs are free. Emits .extraction.completed.v1.

scenarios.title: Preview a migration for older extractions
scenarios.when_to_use: Before v2 activates, ops wants to see what changes for older data — how many extractions need re-run, what fields re-map.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Plan object returned: count of extractions, per-field re-map rules, estimated cost. Ops decides whether to apply.

scenarios.title: Apply the migration — re-run older extractions on v2
scenarios.when_to_use: Ops accepts the plan + applies. Background job re-runs extractions; results stored as new rows linked to the old.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Job_id returned. Re-extractions run async; progress visible. Audit trail links old → new extraction per source.

scenarios.title: Repeat extraction skipped via cache
scenarios.when_to_use: Same source text seen twice (e.g. a duplicate ticket); cached extraction returned for free.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Second call returns the cached result. Cost = 0; no LLM round-trip. Cache TTL configurable.

compliance_posture.notes: Every extraction pinned to the taxonomy version + prompt template version, so a regulator can replay the exact LLM call any time. Migration plans always preview-able for SOX change-management compliance.
